description: "Salmonia; Or, Days of Fly Fishing" by Sir Humphry Davy is a philosophical treatise interwoven with personal reflections and natural history, likely written in the early 19th century. The work unfolds through a series of conversations among four fictional characters—Halieus, Ornither, Poietes, and Physicus—who engage in discussions that extol the joys and intricacies of fly fishing.
